---
title: "The Lab"
---

The course culminates in a practical lab: turn an engineering concept of your
choice into a **2–5 minute educational audio drama**.

The Crossplane restaurant remains the **reference implementation** — it is a
worked example, not a mandatory project. You should choose your own concept so
the process transfers.

Suggested subjects if you cannot decide:

- Kubernetes
- Crossplane
- GitOps
- PKI
- TLS
- OAuth
- DNS
- CI/CD
- event-driven architecture
- message queues
- API gateways
- containers
- dependency injection

## The lab

## Suggested repository structure

```
technical-audio-story/
├── README.md
├── concept.md
├── metaphor.md
├── characters.md
├── scenes.md
├── screenplay.md
├── production.md
├── evaluation.md
├── reflection.md
└── output/
    └── audio-play.mp3

# Optional
├── diagrams/
├── prompts/
├── assets/
└── transcripts/
```

## What "done" means

- A 2–5 minute educational audio drama about a real engineering concept.
- Every stage artifact: concept → metaphor → characters → scenes → screenplay →
  production → evaluation (+ reflection).
- The drama is **technically accurate first** — a beautiful production that
  teaches the wrong architecture does not pass.
- You can explain the underlying technical model because of, not despite, the
  story.
